1// Keep in sync with `hayro-postscript/src/string/ascii_hex.rs`.
2
3use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::trivia::is_white_space_character;
4use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::util::ByteBuf;
5use alloc::vec::Vec;
6
7pub(crate) fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
8    decode_into(data)
9}
10
11pub(crate) fn decode_into<B: ByteBuf>(data: &[u8]) -> Option<B> {
12    // Find end (at `>` or end of data) and check for whitespace.
13    let mut has_whitespace = false;
14    let mut end = data.len();
15
16    for (idx, byte) in data.iter().enumerate() {
17        has_whitespace |= is_white_space_character(*byte);
18
19        if *byte == b'>' {
20            end = idx;
21            break;
22        }
23    }
24
25    let data = &data[..end];
26    let mut decoded = B::with_capacity(data.len().div_ceil(2));
27
28    if !has_whitespace {
29        // Fast path, don't need to worry about white spaces.
30        let (chunks, remainder) = data.as_chunks::<2>();
31
32        for &[hi, lo] in chunks {
33            decoded.push(decode_hex_digit(hi)? << 4 | decode_hex_digit(lo)?);
34        }
35
36        if let [hi] = remainder {
37            decoded.push(decode_hex_digit(*hi)? << 4);
38        }
39    } else {
40        // Slow path, need to strip white spaces.
41        let mut iter = data.iter().copied();
42        let mut read_byte = || -> Option<u8> {
43            loop {
44                let b = iter.next()?;
45                if !is_white_space_character(b) {
46                    return Some(b);
47                }
48            }
49        };
50
51        loop {
52            match (read_byte(), read_byte()) {
53                (Some(hi), Some(lo)) => {
54                    decoded.push(decode_hex_digit(hi)? << 4 | decode_hex_digit(lo)?);
55                }
56                (Some(hi), None) => {
57                    decoded.push(decode_hex_digit(hi)? << 4);
58
59                    break;
60                }
61                (None, _) => break,
62            }
63        }
64    }
65
66    Some(decoded)
67}
68
69#[inline(always)]
70pub(crate) fn decode_hex_digit(c: u8) -> Option<u8> {
71    match c {
72        b'0'..=b'9' => Some(c - b'0'),
73        b'A'..=b'F' => Some(c - b'A' + 10),
74        b'a'..=b'f' => Some(c - b'a' + 10),
75        _ => None,
76    }
77}

79#[cfg(any())]
80mod tests {
81    use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::filter::ascii_hex::decode;
82
83    #[cfg(any())]
84    fn decode_simple() {
85        let input = b"AF3E2901>";
86        assert_eq!(decode(input).unwrap(), vec![0xaf, 0x3e, 0x29, 0x01]);
87    }
88
89    #[cfg(any())]
90    fn decode_whitespaces() {
91        let input = b"AF3   E2   901>";
92        assert_eq!(decode(input).unwrap(), vec![0xaf, 0x3e, 0x29, 0x01]);
93    }
94
95    #[cfg(any())]
96    // Not valid for ASCII hex streams since they require a trailing >,
97    // but used by PDF hex strings as well.
98    fn decode_without_gt() {
99        let input = b"AF3E2901";
100        assert_eq!(decode(input).unwrap(), vec![0xaf, 0x3e, 0x29, 0x01]);
101    }
102
103    #[cfg(any())]
104    fn decode_with_padding() {
105        let input = b"AF3E291>";
106        assert_eq!(decode(input).unwrap(), vec![0xaf, 0x3e, 0x29, 0x10]);
107    }
108}
